text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
...Aaaarrrrggghhh!!! That didn't go the 
way I wanted at all!!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I suppose so. ...I ran with them, so I 
know.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... Um, I'm sorry for being such a 
disgrace.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
...Still, I'm only midway through crawling 
my way back up, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I'll show you how desperately I can 
struggle. I'll struggle and struggle, and 
keep struggling more stubbornly than 
anyone else!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Until the day I face you, Opera O-chan, 
and Doto-chan head-on and win!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"I will absolutely live up to 
expectations!" Because that's... who 
Narita Top Road is!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Then I can still afford to be a little 
selfish, can't I?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Claw your way back up. ...And make sure 
you live up to my expectations.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen concludes— The year turns, 
and the seasons cycle anew.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh? A-Ah, y-yes... Umm, Opera O-san...?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Still, our era is far from over.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Ayabe-san, me, Doto. And Top Road-san.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Let us race. Again and again, let us 
compete. Together, we shall play an 
endless quartet—!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Launching the glory carved by the four 
stars, even into the high-noon sky.
